bull.narrative: Victory Capital Holdings experiences rapid growth, exceeding 15% annual revenue growth due to its strong brand and customer base, leading to a significant increase in market capitalization.

base.narrative: Victory Capital Holdings maintains steady growth, with annual revenue growth of 10-12%, resulting in moderate market capitalization expansion.

bear.narrative: Victory Capital Holdings struggles to adapt to changing market conditions, leading to stagnant revenue growth and a decline in market capitalization.

tracking_note: Currently tracking above projected growth due to strong Q1 earnings.
thesis_breaks_if: Revenue growth fails to exceed 10% annually for 3 consecutive years
